_why: P3039d / t524u: the truth key is the exact mfr+pid couple, never the mfr alone. Homey matches the cartesian mfr x pid of a driver, so a mfr listed on a driver can generate combos no real device reports. For each driver, mfr (lowercase) -> the pids that are REAL for that mfr on that driver (source cited). It checks the paired couple at init: an unlisted pid for a listed mfr is reported once (warning + one notification naming the exact driver when known, P3040), the device keeps working on its current driver with that driver's profile overlaid when available; no re-pair needed. Mfrs not listed are not constrained. lib/utils/CoupleGuard.js (runtime) and scripts/ci/mfr-multi-driver-audit.js (CI) read this file as the reviewed list of real couples.
